Rule 7 native-safe adaptations, all documented in-file: (1) zod is not a native dep -> validateFeedback reproduces the min/max title/body errors and the category enum + boolean shape, FEEDBACK_* constants preserved; (2) react-router-dom useLocation().pathname -> optional pageRoute prop (default '') attached as page_route; (3) import.meta.env.VITE_APP_VERSION -> APP_VERSION='' so the existing 'unknown' fallback renders; (4) navigator.userAgent -> getNativeUserAgent() from React Native Platform; (5) browser-only @/lib/errorReporter is not ported -> inlined native-safe FeedbackErrorReport ring + getRecentReportsForFeedback() (empty until a native reporter populates it); (6) the console tail wraps the global RN console instead of window.console with a typeof console guard.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported.
